color.evidence: DESIGN tokens executed. Audit: contrast_fail_count 0 (92 desktop / 89 mobile), distinct_bg_colors 4, dominant hue 225, cta_hues [218,218], purple_primary false. --action vs --blue still read as one hue.
strengths: Inner pageheads and glass header pick up the tanker/lab wash.
No purple, no gradient type, no card-shadow palette.

issues.problem: --action #013ea8 and --blue #0154a7 both sample hue 218. Filled Request a quote and heading navy read as the same blue.
issues.fix: Keep --blue for headings/links. Set filled .hero .btn background to --deep #012056.

spacing_rhythm.evidence: Audit spacing_grid_adherence 100% on 263 samples; spacing_distinct 8; distinct_radii 1. distinct_shadows 2 are nav-underline and spec-row insets. Split columns still do not share height.
strengths: 100% 4px-grid adherence, one 4px radius, no drop shadows.
Proximity holds in the header, fact strip, spec rows, and form.
Mosaic 0-radius panes with staggered 8px cuts vs 80px section padding.

issues.problem: Split-height system: lab photo fills the left while two short paragraphs leave a tall white void; spec leaves mist under the TDS link beside a 10-row table.
issues.fix: Cap the lab figure at max-height 22rem, or restack unbalanced two-column sections.
